Central Play How to watch Thunder vs. Clippers: TV channel and streaming options for November 13
 By Data Skrive Nov. 13, 2026 Updated 11:04 pm EST Share article 
 The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-4) take the court against the Los Angeles Clippers (2-8) on Nov. 13, 2026.
 How to watch Oklahoma City Thunder vs. Los Angeles Clippers
 Venue: Intuit Dome
 Time: 10:30 p.m. ET
 TV: KSBI, Thunder+, KTLA, ClipperVision
 Streaming (in-market viewers): Fubo (try for free) 
 Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass 
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 Oklahoma City vs. Los Angeles odds
 Spread: Oklahoma City -4.5 (-161), Los Angeles +4.5 (+135)
 Favorite Moneyline: Oklahoma City -286
 Underdog Moneyline: Los Angeles +230
 Total: 222.5
 Total Over Odds: -110
 Total Under Odds: -110
